'''''Bright Sun''''' was a [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]] [[StarTripper]] space [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]]. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]] used this ship, then named '''''She's a Chancer''''', to escape from [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]] after her [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|duel]] with Luke on [[Sinkhole Station]]. She traveled to [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] and sold the yacht to [[Monarg]] for credits to send a holocomm message to the [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Lost Tribe]] and then traveled into the jungle where she encountered the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] and [[Raining Leaves Clan]].

After the [[attack on Bright Sun Hill]], [[Dyon Stadd]] placed a claim on the vessel and renamed it ''Bright Sun'' for the new [[Bright Sun Clan|Dathomiri clan]] formed from the union of the [[Broken Columns Clan]] and the Raining Leaves Clan. Stadd left Dathomir with the [[Jade Shadow]], but both ships were surrounded by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Lost Tribe's]] fleet led by [[Sarasu Taalon]].
